why: a key from a later contract in a document declaring an earlier one. Refused rather than honoured because of who makes this mistake: a producer that grew the key and forgot to raise the number, which is what happened on the control-plane side of the change that added it. Honouring it would mean an old library ignoring the fan-out while a new one performs it, on the same document - the failure the version exists to prevent. A tightening, so no bump.
